(BUT product detail page itself does NOT show the notice — minor). Hosted /pay/demo loaded with Litecoin countdown checkout (no error/expired). i18n JSON integrity PERFECT across all 6 locales (en/de/es/fr/nl/pt) for common.json (1400 keys), dashboardLayout.json (598), landing.json (979) AND backend/locales emails.json (871) — 0 missing keys anywhere.

critical_code_review_comments: /app/pages/settings/index.tsx renders CompanySettingsDialog inline with `open` hardcoded true — defeats the dialog abstraction and mounts the whole tree on /settings. Consider extracting PaymentToleranceSection into its own /settings section component.
ProductCoverFallback: ensure a11y label describes the product name ('Cover for {name}') for screen readers.
/pages/pay/index.tsx is 1907 lines (>700 guideline) — same finding as iteration_98/99. Split into modules.
backend routes: paymentRouter is mounted at '/pay' but also serves /api/pay/creator/:handle. Semantically odd — consider a '/creator' router prefix for public creator endpoints.
